$comment: Marvin (windows and doors, Marvin Family of Brands) runs a server-rendered site with product pages under /products/<type>/<line>/<product>. The product name is the h1 and the description is the meta description; the canonical link is on the page. Marvin sells through dealers and quotes prices per configuration, so there is no price and no stock signal: price and availability are not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. The specifications (sizes, materials, U-factors) are rendered by scripts and are not in the HTML, so no specs are configured. The page is large (about 2 MB), so the service needs a body limit above the default for this site. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title and description; browser: the same, slower; ai-crawler-avalai: the same fields at 955+271 tokens. http is selected: the same data at no cost. Checked against the saved (curl) Elevate Double Hung Window page on 2026-11-19.
